name: v1.6.0
body:
## What's Changed
* update link by @oooooooo in https://github.com/kdabir/has/pull/90
* docs(README): add mise alternate installation documentation by @jylenhof in https://github.com/kdabir/has/pull/92
* feat: added "just" as supported program by @goto-dev-null in https://github.com/kdabir/has/pull/96
* fix: failing unit test assumes dev has `bc` installed by @goto-dev-null in https://github.com/kdabir/has/pull/98
* feat: add shell completions for bash and zsh by @njg7194 in https://github.com/kdabir/has/pull/93
* fix: color flags not working by @goto-dev-null in https://github.com/kdabir/has/pull/97
* Make HAS_ALLOW_UNSAFE case insensitive (closes #35) by @chiliec in https://github.com/kdabir/has/pull/99
* fix: stopped bzip2 from hanging by @goto-dev-null in https://github.com/kdabir/has/pull/94

## New Contributors
* @oooooooo made their first contribution in https://github.com/kdabir/has/pull/90
* @jylenhof made their first contribution in https://github.com/kdabir/has/pull/92
* @goto-dev-null made their first contribution in https://github.com/kdabir/has/pull/96
* @njg7194 made their first contribution in https://github.com/kdabir/has/pull/93
* @chiliec made their first contribution in https://github.com/kdabir/has/pull/99

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/kdabir/has/compare/v1.5.2...v1.6.0
